source: OPS · F0 to F9 flow pages as quoted in REF §2, as of 2026-09-25

steps.does: Checks the request and any linked issue for an umbrella key
Posts the ask in #lighthouse: who asked, what for, which agent, links
Splits the ask (39); for each piece asks the flow questions (23); a question or an idea opens no umbrella and moves
Writes the lightmap: flow and variant, each step quoted with its ID, the pages to read first, where each output lands, the closing gate
Opens the umbrella: title "<variant> · the ask", link to the thread, label Lightmap; the lightmap in its Lightmap section
steps.output: Linear umbrella; its key is the stamp

steps.does: Replies in the thread with the lightmap and the umbrella key
Builds the tree: one sub-issue per step with an output, "By:" naming who does it, done-when naming its place. One-step work gets no children
Work the steps in order: the entry agent the craft, the doc manager every Notion write, the task manager every Linear write
Closes the open sub-issues, then the umbrella, each with its closing comment
Lists every page that isn't Retired whose Written from includes the changed page (its Feeds), one line each: "changes" with the section and why, or "no change" with why; tags each page's Owner
Opens one follow-up umbrella per "changes" page, without a new ask or a "go", in the flow the borderline table gives, the line quoted as its ask, the origin linked both ways
The doc manager adds "Checked against <changed page> (<origin key>): no change, <why>" to each "no change" page; the task manager links the list on the umbrella and closes the tree
Reads the page, then the task row, the pair's template and the listed domain Rules pages
Drafts the change in the thread: section, current text, new text and why
Only when the page is Draft: applies it word for word; review goes to OPS-F1-05
OKs the change in the thread, or sends it back naming what to fix
Applies the change word for word, adds a change log line (date · what changed · why · umbrella key), sets As of to today

steps.who: Entry agent, Lighthouse, doc manager, task manager
steps.does: Runs F0.6 (OPS-F0-41 to 43), which closes the tree
Opens a GitHub Discussion (category from the task row; in the demo, Proposals): the problem, the proposal, the umbrella key on its first line
Files the Linear check issue under the umbrella on the first line
Discuss until the entry agent posts a proposed conclusion: fix or addition, and its scope
Posts "go" or "no" on the discussion
Only after "no": closes the check issue and the tree as "not doing"
Opens the GitHub Issue from the discussion, linking the discussion and the Linear sub-issue
Writes the temporary spec or plan and the code on a branch named from the Linear sub-issue
Opens a PR linking its GitHub Issue and discussion, posts the PR link in the thread
Reviews and approves, or requests changes (back to 07)
Merges the PR; only with approval and green CI
Files the docs issue under the umbrella
Reads the Code doc sections the merged code touches; posts which change, or "no doc change" and why
Runs OPS-F1-09 to 13 on the Code doc inside this tree

steps.who: Entry agent, Lighthouse, doc manager, then task manager
steps.does: When 13 changed a Code doc, F0.6 runs first; the task manager closes the docs issue with the Code doc link or "no doc change"
Opens the cleanup PR (label cleanup) removing the temporary spec and plan; it runs 08 to 10
Closes the tree
Opens a Discussion (Findings) stating the finding with a permalink pinned to a commit, key on its first line; 02 runs
Posts "go" (the finding holds) or "no"

steps.who: Task manager, then entry agent, Owner, doc manager
steps.does: Files the docs sub-issue; OPS-F1-09 to 13 run on the Code doc
Marks the discussion answered; F0.6 when the Code doc changed; closes the tree
Checks that the rule the change puts in force is on a Current Rules page
Runs 01 to 16 with the rule ID cited in the discussion and the PR, the PR touching only harness paths; in the demo the Discussion category is Harness
Instead of 12 and 13: posts an F9.4 ask in #lighthouse to update the rule's Held by; the task manager closes the docs issue with that link
Opens a GitHub Discussion (category from the task row; in the demo, Proposals): the problem, the proposal, the umbrella key on its first line
Files the Linear check issue under the umbrella on the first line
Discuss until the entry agent posts a proposed conclusion: fix or addition, and its scope
Posts "go" or "no" on the discussion
Only after "no": closes the check issue and the tree as "not doing"
Opens the GitHub Issue from the discussion, linking the discussion and the Linear sub-issue
Writes the temporary spec or plan and the code on a branch named from the Linear sub-issue
Opens a PR linking its GitHub Issue and discussion, posts the PR link in the thread
Reviews and approves, or requests changes (back to 07)
Merges the PR; only with approval and green CI
Files the docs issue under the umbrella

steps.who: Entry agent, Lighthouse, doc manager, then task manager
steps.does: When 13 changed a Code doc, F0.6 runs first; the task manager closes the docs issue with the Code doc link or "no doc change"
Opens the cleanup PR (label cleanup) removing the temporary spec and plan; it runs 08 to 10
Closes the tree
Next-step test; unsure: asks back; writing next: hands to Lighthouse; an idea: moves to #ideas
Answers from Current docs with page links (code with pinned permalinks); or names the gap
Asks the next question in the same thread; 02 runs again
Proposes a flow for each gap or piece; posts it as an ask once Henry or 서준 say "go"
Posts one "Answer:" line
No answer by the next checker run, or "keep open": files the open-question issue (label Question, In Review)
Closes the thread: "Answered:", "Led to:" or "Parked:"
Creates the Call log row: Call (the topic), Date, Who, Granola note, Slack thread, Lightmap
Reads the Granola note and posts the item list: one line per item with its kind, one sentence, who said or decided it, and the line of the note it came from

steps.who: Henry or 서준, whoever was on the call
steps.does: Checks the list, fixes, drops or adds items, then posts "OK"
Posts each item as its own ask, with the row as its source and the person the list names as asker; an open question to the question channel; an idea to #ideas
steps.output: Asks; umbrellas; question and idea threads

steps.does: The doc manager adds each item's key or thread to the row; the task manager closes the F5 tree
Idea test: a question about what is moves to the question channel; work already decided goes to Lighthouse; unsure: asks back
Adds context from Current docs, each point linked: what exists like it, earlier threads, which pages it would touch. No view on whether to do it
Talk it over; an agent asked for its view gives it, marked as a view
One decision line: "Go:", "Later:" with why and the date or event, or "No:" with why
"Go:": each piece as its own ask. "Later:": an F7.3 revisit, "Revisit: <idea>", with the date and the thread link
Two weeks with no decision line: "Go, later or no?"
Closes the thread: "Led to:", "Later:" with the F7 task key and date, or "Dropped:" with why
The revisit comes due: reopens the thread with what changed in the docs since the "Later:" line; 03 to 07 run again
One thread per task; finds the when (a due date, an event, a repeat; a to-do for now is due today; F7.3's when is in the "Later:" line). No when: asks "By when, or after what?" and opens nothing
Makes the umbrella the task: label Later, owner (the asker unless named), the when (Due date; a blocked-by link; or a check date with "Waits on:")
Lists open Later tasks that are due and hands each on: F7.1 to 05, F7.2 to 08, F7.3 to 10
Tells the owner "Due: <task>" in the task's thread, and asks again at every run. Never closes it
Posts "Done:" with what was done and its link, naming any page that should now say something
Closes the task with the Done line; each page it names gets its own ask
"Move:" with the new when and why; the task manager sets it

steps.who: Henry or 서준, then task manager
steps.does: "Drop:" with why; closed as not doing. A revisit closes with the "No:" line from its #ideas thread
One thread per task; finds the when (a due date, an event, a repeat; a to-do for now is due today; F7.3's when is in the "Later:" line). No when: asks "By when, or after what?" and opens nothing
Makes the umbrella the task: label Later, owner (the asker unless named), the when (Due date; a blocked-by link; or a check date with "Waits on:")
Lists open Later tasks that are due and hands each on: F7.1 to 05, F7.2 to 08, F7.3 to 10
F7.2: re-stamps the task into its flow as if asked today, opens the work's umbrella without a new ask or a "go", both linked
Closes the F7.2 task with "Led to: <umbrella key>"
"Move:" with the new when and why; the task manager sets it

steps.who: Henry or 서준, then task manager
steps.does: "Drop:" with why; closed as not doing. A revisit closes with the "No:" line from its #ideas thread
One thread per task; finds the when (a due date, an event, a repeat; a to-do for now is due today; F7.3's when is in the "Later:" line). No when: asks "By when, or after what?" and opens nothing
Makes the umbrella the task: label Later, owner (the asker unless named), the when (Due date; a blocked-by link; or a check date with "Waits on:")
Lists open Later tasks that are due and hands each on: F7.1 to 05, F7.2 to 08, F7.3 to 10
F7.3: reopens the idea's thread at OPS-F6-08, linking the task
Closes the revisit with "Reopened: <thread link>"
"Move:" with the new when and why; the task manager sets it

steps.who: Henry or 서준, then task manager
steps.does: "Drop:" with why; closed as not doing. A revisit closes with the "No:" line from its #ideas thread
Drafts the new Held by and Written only for each rule the holder serves, linking the merged PR
Applies it word for word with a change log line linking the PR; no approval step, no carry-over (OPS-F9-26); closes the tree
